interpretation_policy: All matches are provisional title/context observations. They never establish military intent, independent source confirmation, likelihood ratios, alerts or approved reviews. Missing coverage is unknown, never negative.

direct_state_engagement.label: Direct state engagement or cross-border strike
direct_state_engagement.discriminator: Seek independent attribution to state forces and a verified incident, not just an allegation or syndicated headline.

force_concentration.label: Extraordinary force preparation
force_concentration.discriminator: Compare with recurring exercises and the theater's historical training or deployment baseline.

maritime_interdiction.label: Maritime interdiction or shipping disruption
maritime_interdiction.discriminator: Distinguish physical interruption from scheduled navigation warnings, routine exercises, and generalized reporting.

airspace_closure.label: Atypical airspace restriction or civilian flight interruption
airspace_closure.discriminator: Check whether the restriction is exceptional and attributable to the relevant security scenario.

border_closure.label: Exceptional border/trade crossing restriction
border_closure.discriminator: Verify actual crossing changes against normal travel, customs, and domestic-security restrictions.

civilian_protection.label: Civilian protection or evacuation action
civilian_protection.discriminator: Distinguish conflict-driven protective action from localized violence and environmental disasters.

diplomatic_breakdown.label: Exceptional diplomatic rupture or ceasefire breakdown
diplomatic_breakdown.pattern: \b(?:expel(?:led|s)? diplomats?|expulsion of diplomats|closed (?:the )?consulate|consular closure|ceasefire (?:collapsed|broken|suspended)|peace talks (?:collapsed|suspended)|diplomatic relations (?:severed|broken))\b
diplomatic_breakdown.discriminator: Diplomatic signaling is meaningful but cannot by itself demonstrate a decision for direct military action.

network_disruption.label: Network or infrastructure disruption (attribution unknown)
network_disruption.discriminator: Require a source-verified local anomaly and separate technical or natural causes from deliberate action.

scheduled_training.label: Scheduled/routine exercise explanation
scheduled_training.pattern: \b(?:firing exercises?|live[- ]fire exercise|military exercises?|naval exercises?|routine drill|scheduled exercise|training area|exercise warning|training exercise|missile test|weapons test)\b
scheduled_training.discriminator: Routine exercises can explain closures or deployments, but cannot exclude opportunistic escalation.

diplomatic_deescalation.label: Diplomatic de-escalation or functioning contacts
diplomatic_deescalation.discriminator: Mediation and talks can coexist with preparation. This is a competing-explanation cue, not proof of safety.

localized_conflict.label: Continuing localized/proxy conflict explanation
localized_conflict.pattern: \b(?:tigray fighting|m23 (?:fighting|advance|clash)|counterinsurgency (?:raid|operation)|localized (?:fighting|clashes)|internal fighting|insurgency fighting|counterterrorism raid|border skirmish|rebel fighting)\b
localized_conflict.discriminator: Ongoing violence may generate many alerts without a distinct new interstate escalation.

natural_hazard.label: Environmental disruption as a confounder
natural_hazard.discriminator: A hazard can explain civil restrictions without hostile military intent.
